deadlines.label: Notice of Intent (encouraged, not required)
deadlines.quote: Notice of Intent Encouraged, not Required May 18, 2026, 5:00 PM ET

deadlines.label: Phase I final report must reach the NIAC Program Office by the Phase II proposal due date and time
deadlines.quote: Phase I final reports must be submitted to the NIAC Program Office, e.g., emailed to hq-niac@mail.nasa.gov , by the Phase II proposal due date and time.

match.quote: There are no requirements for Phase II cost sharing or funds matching.

award.quote: Phase II awards are for up to two years at a total funding level of up to $750k per award

sections.name: Overview Chart
sections.quote: The Overview Chart must follow the template provided in Figure 1 and included on the NSPIRES NIAC Phase II site.

sections.name: Compliance Table
sections.quote: It must be one page long and include each element of the evaluation criteria as noted in section F.1.

sections.name: NIAC Phase I Key Findings
sections.quote: This section should succinctly summarize the major outcomes of the NIAC Phase I study.

sections.name: Technical and Management Section
sections.quote: This section should describe how the Phase I concept will continue to be developed. This section should include a discussion of the major feasibility issues to be studied in Phase II.

criteria.name: #1 Concept Progression
criteria.quote: The proposed research objectives build on the Phase I study findings while also demonstrating unexplored, exciting, and valuable aspects to investigate beyond the Phase I study.

criteria.name: #2 Technical Study Approach
criteria.quote: A work plan is proposed that demonstrates an understanding of major issues and proposes a logical, strategic, and judicious course of study

criteria.name: #3 Representative Mission
criteria.quote: The proposal describes a specific representative mission in sufficient detail to enable the assessment of proposed technology benefits by a cognizant reviewer

criteria.name: #4 Potential Impact
criteria.quote: The concept is exciting and offers compelling potential benefit.

format.lineSpacing: no more than 5.5 lines per vertical inch
other: Body text and captions may not exceed 15 characters per horizontal inch, including spaces, on average across a solid block of text
Expository text may not be located solely in figures, tables, or their captions
Attachment includes only the listed sections, in the order listed
Overview Chart in landscape format, may be rotated to fit 11 x 8.5 inches with one-inch margins
TeX/LaTeX users must create a DVI file, convert to Postscript, then to PDF
Reviewers will not consider content beyond the page limits
format.quote: Proposals may not have more than 5.5 lines per vertical inch of text, must have at least one-inch margins, be set for US letter size (8.5x11) paper

eligibility.item: Open to all categories of U.S. organizations that have completed, or are actively completing, a NIAC Phase I study that has not previously received a Phase II award
eligibility.quote: This Appendix is open to all categories of U.S. organizations, providing they have successfully completed, or are actively completing, a NIAC Phase I study that has not previously received a Phase II award.

eligibility.item: NIAC Fellows or designees of the predecessor NASA Institute for Advanced Concepts may not submit Phase II proposals based on those prior Phase I studies
eligibility.quote: NIAC Fellows or their designees of the predecessor NASA Institute for Advanced Concepts are no longer eligible to submit Phase II proposals based on those prior Phase I studies.

eligibility.item: The Phase I final report must be submitted to the NIAC Program Office by the Phase II proposal due date and time, or the proposal will not be reviewed
eligibility.quote: If the Phase I final report is not received by this date and time, the submitted proposal will not be reviewed

eligibility.item: Individuals proposed to receive NIAC funding must be affiliated with a U.S. organization
eligibility.quote: Individuals proposed to receive NIAC funding must be affiliated with a U.S. organization.

eligibility.item: Individuals not affiliated with a U.S. organization must obtain a UEI and CAGE Code from SAM.gov before proposal submission
eligibility.quote: Individuals not affiliated with a U.S. organization must receive a Unique Entity Identifier and Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code from SAM.gov prior to NIAC proposal submission.

eligibility.item: Non-U.S. organizations may participate only on a no-exchange-of-funds basis, subject to NASA's foreign participation policy
eligibility.quote: Non-U.S. organizations may participate in NIAC studies on a no-exchange of funds basis

eligibility.item: Previously declined proposals may be resubmitted
eligibility.quote: Proposals that had previously been declined for award may be resubmitted, consistent with the requirements of this solicitation.

eligibility.item: The Phase II concept must be essentially based on the Phase I concept
eligibility.quote: the Phase II concept must be essentially based on the Phase I concept.

eligibility.item: Proposals may be submitted via NSPIRES only
eligibility.quote: Proposals may be submitted via NSPIRES only.

eligibility.item: All team personnel on the electronic cover page must be individually registered and affiliated with their organization in NSPIRES, each with one organizational affiliation
eligibility.quote: All team personnel listed on the proposal’s electronic cover page must be individually registered and affiliated with their organization in NSPIRES.

eligibility.item: A Co-Principal Investigator (Co-PI) designation is not accepted
eligibility.quote: Note that NIAC does not accept a designation of Co-Principal Investigator (Co-PI).

requiredDocuments.item: Proposal Cover Page (generated by the NSPIRES web form)
requiredDocuments.quote: Proposers will provide the required information and NSPIRES will generate the Proposal Cover Page automatically.
A Table of Contents helps reviewers find specific proposal content. One page is preferred but can be exceeded if necessary.

requiredDocuments.item: Biographical sketch for each senior/key person (PI and Co-Is at 10% or more effort), on the NASA form
requiredDocuments.quote: A biographical sketch must be included for senior/key personnel listed on the cover page.

requiredDocuments.item: Current and pending (other) support form for each senior/key person
requiredDocuments.quote: Each senior/key person listed on a proposal is required to submit current and pending support disclosures with their application.

requiredDocuments.item: Letter of Commitment from the owner of any facility or resource not under the proposer's direct control (no team-member commitment letters or letters of affirmation)
requiredDocuments.quote: NIAC only requires a Letter of Commitment from the owner of any facility or resource not under the proposer’s direct control, acknowledging its availability for the proposed period of use.

requiredDocuments.item: Budget Justification substantiating the overall budget request
requiredDocuments.quote: A justification for the proposed expenditures must be included in the proposal. It must substantiate the overall budget request

requiredDocuments.item: Data Management Plan, entered in the program-specific data form of the NSPIRES cover page
requiredDocuments.quote: All proposals submitted under this NOFO are required to provide a Data Management Plan (DMP)

requiredDocuments.item: Completed Vertebrate Animal and Higher Order Cephalopod Section (VACS) form, for proposals involving animal research
requiredDocuments.quote: Completed Vertebrate Animal and Higher Order Cephalopod Section (VACS) Form (for proposals involving animal research)
